lines.intro: This is the Experiments tab of your forge. Four steps: a baseline, one change, the same questions again, then before and after.
lines.baseline: This knob shows only when something goes wrong, so we use the three error questions: a code written wrong, a closed cost centre, and a date in the past. Run 1 is the shipped toolbox: three of three right.
lines.pick: Pick: raw error codes everywhere. When a call fails, the tool now passes on Ledgerline's own code, with no words and no next step.
lines.settings: Your settings list the change, on every tool.
lines.run: Run the three error questions again. Here it is sped up.
lines.result: Before and after. The same score, three of three, and almost the same tokens.
lines.tiles: So did the knob do nothing? Look at what the model actually read.
lines.table: Almost the same tools, on every question.
lines.trace: Open question E3, the date in the past.
lines.trace2: The refusal is now just a code, E R R P R 0105, and four words: need date in past. No next step. This model still worked it out. A vaguer code, or a weaker model, may not. Words and a next step cost almost nothing, and remove the guess.
lines.next: Next: try another change, or set one by hand on the Anvil. After two or three knobs, go on to the Shield.
